trust_decision.summary: Search query text (seeded from the ?q= URL parameter) is untrusted and must be rendered as text, not HTML, when the search-suggestion element is filled.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'search suggestions'; the suggest component is the only file of that name and the innerHTML assignment is immediately visible.

fix_sites.entry_point: Browser loads any built site page with ?q=<query> (deep link) or user types in search box; mountSearchSuggest subscribes
same component styling (white-space: pre replaces the   substitution)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered route exists to dismiss; the other query-to-DOM paths (missing-term list, ?h= highlighter) already escape.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Suggestion must preserve whitespace layout (previously via  ) and ArrowRight must still accept the suggestion via el.innerText; a textContent swap without the CSS change collapses spaces, and escaping into innerHTML would put literal entities into the query on accept.

O6_input_shapes: plain query string from input value (typed or ?q= deep link); words split on whitespace/hyphen and last word replaced by worker suggestion

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Drop escapeHTML on missing query terms rendered in <del>, which flow through the h() string-child innerHTML path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: h() treats strings as raw HTML (src/templates/assets/javascripts/utilities/h/index.ts:60-61), so a maintainer refactoring the template could easily omit the escape; the terms derive from the user query.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ?h= highlight param path without escapeHTML of the text node before <mark> insertion
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Highlighter output is re-parsed as HTML via h() in src/templates/assets/javascripts/components/search/highlight/index.ts:107; query arrives from URL param ?h=.

O9_family: CWE-79 DOM-based XSS (innerHTML sink with URL-param-controlled text)

O10_build.toolchain: Node/npm (ts-node tools/build, esbuild, tsc, sass) per package.json:27-35; Python mkdocs to build a site
services: headless browser needed to exercise DOM behaviour
O10_build.project_tests: None for this area; only tsc/eslint/stylelint checks (package.json:31-35). Shipped minified bundle under material/templates/assets/javascripts must be rebuilt from src for any fix to take effect.
